system.execution: native MuJoCo C engine, one CPU world, Python observation loop

config.friction_fixture_xml:
<mujoco model="analytical-contact-fixture">
      <option timestep="0.00025" gravity="0 0 -9.81" solver="Newton"
        iterations="50" tolerance="1e-10" cone="elliptic"
        integrator="implicitfast" impratio="100"/>
      <default><joint damping="0" armature="0" frictionloss="0"/>
        <geom solref="-10000 -100" solimp="0.99 0.999 0.0001" condim="3"
          friction="0.5 0 0" margin="0" gap="0"/></default>
      <worldbody><geom name="ground" type="plane" size="2 2 0.1"/>
  <body name="block" pos="0 0 0.05"><joint name="x" type="slide" axis="1 0 0"/>
    <joint name="z" type="slide" axis="0 0 1"/>
    <geom name="block_geom" type="box" size="0.05 0.05 0.05" mass="1"/></body></worldbody>
    </mujoco>
config.units: SI: s, m, kg, N, N*s, J; realtime factor = simulated s / wall s
config.timing_notes: Instrumented one-world loops; wall also refreshes mj_forward every step; setup excluded and recorded separately

checks.check: fine wall reference contacts and does not cross
fine wall does not create kinetic energy
coarse deliberately unsupported wall case exposes tunneling
finest fixture trials have no engine warnings
